stopped.text: The freed facility patches up trainers cheaply: healing works better for the rest of the run.

through.text: They keep the facility: healing works worse for the rest of the run.

stopped.text: The rescued Pokémon spread the word: wild Pokémon trust you more (better catch rate).

through.text: Stolen Poké Balls flood the market and wild Pokémon grow wary (worse catch rate).

stopped.text: Their stolen research is now yours: more Research Points for the rest of the run.

through.text: Their research pays off: enemy Pokémon reach Hyper states more often.

stopped.text: The guardian is safe and grateful: Legendary Pokémon turn up more often.

through.text: The guardian has fled into hiding: Legendary Pokémon turn up less often.

stopped.text: With the black market shut, honest merchants lower their prices.

through.text: The black market drives up prices in every shop.

stopped.text: Trainers who almost joined them train with you instead: a little more EXP.

through.text: Their ranks swell: every enemy is a level higher.

stopped.text: The grateful organizers pay you well: more prize money.

through.text: Events are cancelled and prize money dries up.

stopped.text: The town is free again and its people help your Pokémon feel at home (more friendship).

through.text: They charge a toll everywhere they rule: Poké Balls cost more.

stopped.text: The experiment is shut down: enemy Pokémon lose their edge (fewer Hyper states).

through.text: The experiment worked: enemy Pokémon reach Hyper states more often.

stopped.text: You saved the artificial Pokémon's blueprints: more Research Points.

through.text: Their creation guards the bosses: boss Pokémon take less damage.

stopped.text: The habitat recovers: rare Pokémon turn up more often.

through.text: The habitat is ruined: rare Pokémon turn up less often.

teams.name: Team Rocket
teams.philosophy: Pokémon are tools, and profit is the only law.
teams.motivation: Giovanni wants a criminal empire that answers to no one.
teams.goal: steal the strongest Pokémon in every region and sell them to the highest bidder

lines.first: "Hey! This is Team Rocket business. Scram!"
lines.beaten: "You again? The boss chewed me out because of you!"
lines.winning: "Back for another beating? Team Rocket never forgets a face."
lines.respect: "...Okay, you're tough. I'm just doing my job, all right?"

lines.first: "A trainer with a healthy team. You'd make a fine test subject."
lines.beaten: "My numbers said you would lose. I need new numbers."
lines.winning: "As predicted. Your Pokémon are data now."
lines.respect: "Fascinating. You keep breaking my models."

lines.first: "So you're the brat sticking your nose into our affairs."
lines.beaten: "You embarrassed me last time. I don't get embarrassed twice."
lines.winning: "Remember how that ended? Walk away while you can."
lines.respect: "Giovanni has heard your name. That is not a compliment... mostly."

lines.first: "So this is the child who has been ruining my business."
lines.beaten: "You beat me once. Do you think the world changes because of it?"
lines.winning: "You lost to me before. Kneel, and keep what you have left."
lines.respect: "You remind me of someone. Very well. Show me everything."

rule.text: Rocket never fights fair: one more Pokémon in every battle.

ops.name: Pokémon Heist
ops.text: Rocket grunts are loading stolen Poké Balls into an unmarked van.

ops.name: Black Market
ops.text: A back-alley stall sells Pokémon with no papers and no questions.

ops.name: Radio Tower Takeover
ops.text: Rocket has seized the local radio tower and is broadcasting a strange signal.

ops.name: Forced Evolution Lab
ops.text: A hidden machine is forcing wild Pokémon to evolve, and it hurts them.

teams.name: Team Aqua
teams.philosophy: The sea gave birth to all life, so the sea should cover the land.
teams.motivation: Archie believes the land crowds out the ocean's Pokémon.
teams.goal: wake Kyogre and raise the seas over the land

lines.first: "Hey! This is Team Aqua business. Scram!"
lines.beaten: "You again? The boss chewed me out because of you!"
lines.winning: "Back for another beating? Team Aqua never forgets a face."
lines.respect: "...Okay, you're tough. I'm just doing my job, all right?"

lines.first: "Down here the sea decides who stays. Not you."
lines.beaten: "The tide turned once. It turns back."
lines.winning: "You sank last time. Want to try swimming again?"
lines.respect: "You swim against the current and win. Respect."

lines.first: "Ahahaha! A little land-dweller wants to play?"
lines.beaten: "You got lucky. The sea always comes back for what it lost."
lines.winning: "Ahaha, you again! Did you dry off from last time?"
lines.respect: "Hmph. Archie keeps asking about you. Don't let it go to your head."

lines.first: "Bwahaha! You're standing on my future ocean floor!"
lines.beaten: "You stopped me once. The sea is patient, and so am I."
lines.winning: "Still on dry land? Not for long, kid."
lines.respect: "Fine! Then let's see whose waves are stronger!"

rule.text: Aqua admins bring fewer Pokémon, trained harder: one less Pokémon, two levels higher.

ops.name: Coastal Dig
ops.text: Aqua grunts are digging up a nesting beach to flood it.

ops.name: Submarine Theft
ops.text: Team Aqua is stealing a research submarine from the docks.

ops.name: Deep Sea Survey
ops.text: Aqua divers are mapping the trench where a giant sleeps.

ops.name: Harbor Lockdown
ops.text: Team Aqua has closed the harbor and charges a toll to pass.

teams.name: Team Magma
teams.philosophy: Land is where life thrives; the seas must shrink to make room.
teams.motivation: Maxie wants more land for people and Pokémon alike, whatever it costs.
teams.goal: wake Groudon and boil the seas away

lines.first: "Hey! This is Team Magma business. Scram!"
lines.beaten: "You again? The boss chewed me out because of you!"
lines.winning: "Back for another beating? Team Magma never forgets a face."
lines.respect: "...Okay, you're tough. I'm just doing my job, all right?"

lines.first: "The ground here is warm. Very warm. Leave."
lines.beaten: "My readings never lie. My battles, apparently, do."
lines.winning: "The magma doesn't care about you, and neither do I."
lines.respect: "Your team is as stubborn as bedrock."

lines.first: "Hehehe! The leader told me to deal with pests like you."
lines.beaten: "You again! The leader won't forgive me twice!"
lines.winning: "Hehehe, back for more lava?"
lines.respect: "Hehe... you're not a pest anymore. You're a problem."

lines.first: "Fufufu... a child, here? You do not understand what is at stake."
lines.beaten: "You defeated me once. A miscalculation I have since corrected."
lines.winning: "You remember the heat of our last battle. Turn back."
lines.respect: "Logic says you should not keep winning. Show me how."

rule.text: Magma admins bring fewer Pokémon, trained harder: one less Pokémon, two levels higher.

ops.name: Volcano Drill
ops.text: Team Magma has taken over a geothermal plant to drill into the volcano.

ops.name: Meteorite Heist
ops.text: Magma grunts are stealing a meteorite from the observatory.

ops.name: Magma Survey
ops.text: Magma geologists are listening for a heartbeat deep under the mountain.

ops.name: Hot Spring Closure
ops.text: Team Magma has fenced off the town's hot springs as "private land".

teams.name: Team Galactic
teams.philosophy: Spirit is a flaw; a new world without it would be perfect.
teams.motivation: Cyrus wants to unmake this world and build one without feelings.
teams.goal: chain the lords of time and space with the Red Chain

lines.first: "Hey! This is Team Galactic business. Scram!"
lines.beaten: "You again? The boss chewed me out because of you!"
lines.winning: "Back for another beating? Team Galactic never forgets a face."
lines.respect: "...Okay, you're tough. I'm just doing my job, all right?"

lines.first: "Energy readings spike when you are near. Curious."
lines.beaten: "An error. Errors are corrected."
lines.winning: "The experiment worked. On you."
lines.respect: "I am starting to doubt the model. Do not tell Cyrus."

lines.first: "You're the kid poking around our lakes? Cute."
lines.beaten: "You beat me, and I hate that! This time I'm serious!"
lines.winning: "Last time went my way. I bet it will again."
lines.respect: "Ugh. Fine. You're actually good. Happy?"

lines.first: "You are an obstacle. Obstacles are removed."
lines.beaten: "You stopped me once. Feelings again. How tiresome."
lines.winning: "You lost before. Spirit did not save you."
lines.respect: "Perhaps... a world needs one like you. No. Battle me."

rule.text: Galactic machines seal hearts: their first Pokémon is a Shadow Pokémon you can snag and save.

ops.name: Lake Raid
ops.text: Galactic grunts are setting bombs at a lake where a guardian sleeps.

ops.name: Power Plant Takeover
ops.text: Galactic Energy has bought the local power plant and turned the lights off.

ops.name: Spirit Extraction Lab
ops.text: Scientists are draining the "spirit" from captured Pokémon.

ops.name: Warehouse Raid
ops.text: Galactic is emptying a warehouse of Poké Balls and fossils.

teams.name: Team Plasma
teams.philosophy: Pokémon should be freed from trainers... so that only Plasma keeps them.
teams.motivation: Ghetsis uses a speech about freedom to take the world's Pokémon.
teams.goal: make every trainer release their Pokémon so only Plasma commands any

lines.first: "Hey! This is Team Plasma business. Scram!"
lines.beaten: "You again? The boss chewed me out because of you!"
lines.winning: "Back for another beating? Team Plasma never forgets a face."
lines.respect: "...Okay, you're tough. I'm just doing my job, all right?"

lines.first: "I want to see what brings out a Pokémon's full power. You will help."
lines.beaten: "Marvelous! Losing teaches me more than winning."
lines.winning: "Ah, you again. My data says you will lose."
lines.respect: "You are the most interesting variable I have found."

lines.first: "Release your Pokémon, child. It is for their own good."
lines.beaten: "You humiliated a Sage! Plasma does not forgive."
lines.winning: "Did you reflect on your sins since our last meeting?"
lines.respect: "You love those Pokémon. That is... inconvenient for us."

lines.first: "Liberation! Such a lovely word. I made it mine."
lines.beaten: "You ruined my plan once. Do not mistake that for victory."
lines.winning: "Did you enjoy losing? I enjoyed watching."
lines.respect: "Then I will crush you with my own hands!"

rule.text: Plasma crowds you with followers: one more Pokémon in every battle.

ops.name: Liberation Rally
ops.text: Plasma speakers are convincing trainers to give up their Pokémon.

ops.name: "Rescue" Drive
ops.text: Plasma grunts in fake ranger coats are taking Pokémon "for their safety".

ops.name: Frigate Dock
ops.text: Plasma is fitting an ice cannon to a flying frigate in the harbor.

ops.name: Ancient Revival Project
ops.text: Plasma scientists are rebuilding an ancient Pokémon as a weapon.

teams.name: Team Flare
teams.philosophy: The world is ugly; only a chosen few deserve a beautiful future.
teams.motivation: Lysandre wants to save the world by wiping out almost everyone in it.
teams.goal: fire the ultimate weapon and keep the future for Flare alone

lines.first: "Hey! This is Team Flare business. Scram!"
lines.beaten: "You again? The boss chewed me out because of you!"
lines.winning: "Back for another beating? Team Flare never forgets a face."
lines.respect: "...Okay, you're tough. I'm just doing my job, all right?"

lines.first: "Team Flare pays very well. Your Pokémon could make me rich."
lines.beaten: "My stylish plans! Ruined by an unstylish child!"
lines.winning: "How unfashionable of you to come back."
lines.respect: "Even I must admit: that was elegant."

lines.first: "Only the beautiful get a ticket to the future. You don't have one."
lines.beaten: "You ruined my outfit and my plan. Unforgivable."
lines.winning: "Ah, the loser from before. Still no ticket?"
lines.respect: "Perhaps... you could have had a ticket after all."

lines.first: "The world is too crowded. I will make it beautiful."
lines.beaten: "You stopped me before. The world will still end, only later."
lines.winning: "You failed last time. Give up your future."
lines.respect: "You would protect this ugly world with everything you have? Then show me."

rule.text: Flare sends only its stylish best: one less Pokémon, two levels higher.

ops.name: Power Plant Seizure
ops.text: Flare grunts in red suits are running the local power plant.

ops.name: Mega Stone Mining
ops.text: Flare is strip-mining a cave full of Mega Stones and sleeping Pokémon.

ops.name: Weapon Research
ops.text: A Flare lab is studying an ancient weapon that drains life.

ops.name: Future Tickets
ops.text: Flare is selling "tickets to the future" for five million each.

teams.name: Team Skull
teams.philosophy: Nobody gave us a chance, so we take what we want.
teams.motivation: Guzma's misfits want respect, and money from whoever pays.
teams.goal: do the dirty work for a rich patron and take every island trial by force

lines.first: "Yo yo yo! What you lookin' at?"
lines.beaten: "Yo, not you again! My bad, my bad!"
lines.winning: "Ha! Remember last time? We got you, yo!"
lines.respect: "Aight, you're legit. Don't tell Guzma I said that."

lines.first: "This wall's ours now, and so is this road."
lines.beaten: "You messed up my art, yo!"
lines.winning: "Back for another tag? You're it!"
lines.respect: "Aight. You can pass. This one time."

lines.first: "So you're the one picking on my grunts."
lines.beaten: "You made my kids cry. Now I'm mad."
lines.winning: "Remember how that went? Go home."
lines.respect: "Huh. You're all right. Those idiots could learn from you."

lines.first: "Guzma! Destruction in human form! Who're you?"
lines.beaten: "You beat Guzma once. Guzma doesn't lose twice!"
lines.winning: "Heh. You're still standing? Not for long."
lines.respect: "...Fine. You're the real deal. Let's go all out!"

rule.text: Skull runs in packs: one more Pokémon in every battle.

ops.name: Pokémon Snatching
ops.text: Skull grunts are grabbing Pokémon from a daycare.

ops.name: Trial Crashing
ops.text: Team Skull has crashed a local trial and is blocking every challenger.

ops.name: Town Takeover
ops.text: Team Skull has taken over an abandoned town and charges a "fee" to pass.

ops.name: Recruitment Drive
ops.text: Skull is recruiting kids who failed their trials.

teams.name: Aether Foundation
teams.philosophy: Beautiful Pokémon must be protected... by being kept in glass forever.
teams.motivation: Lusamine wants to own what she loves, including creatures from another world.
teams.goal: open an Ultra Wormhole and claim the beasts beyond it

lines.first: "Welcome to Aether! This area is restricted, thank you."
lines.beaten: "Please, no more trouble! My review is next week!"
lines.winning: "Security has been informed about you. Again."
lines.respect: "Between us... I don't like what happens downstairs either."

lines.first: "Our research is for the good of all Pokémon. Mostly."
lines.beaten: "You damaged a prototype! Do you know what those cost?"
lines.winning: "Results are results. Thank you for the data."
lines.respect: "You... could have been a great researcher."

lines.first: "I am the Branch Chief. You will address me properly."
lines.beaten: "You dare humiliate the Branch Chief twice?!"
lines.winning: "Ah, the child I defeated. How did that feel?"
lines.respect: "Hmph. Perhaps I underestimated you. Slightly."

lines.first: "Such a lovely child. I could keep you in a case too."
lines.beaten: "You broke my collection once. I will not let you touch it again."
lines.winning: "You lost to me before. Stay still, darling."
lines.respect: "Why will you not simply be beautiful and still?"

rule.text: Aether fields its finest specimens: one less Pokémon, two levels higher.

ops.name: Preservation Wing
ops.text: Aether has opened a "preservation" lab that freezes rescued Pokémon.

ops.name: Wormhole Research
ops.text: Aether is measuring energy from a crack in the sky.

ops.name: Project Type: Null
ops.text: Aether is building an artificial Pokémon to fight the beasts.

ops.name: Sanctuary Closure
ops.text: Aether has fenced off a wild sanctuary as "protected property".

teams.name: Team Yell
teams.philosophy: Marnie must win, and nobody else gets a fair chance.
teams.motivation: Loud, loyal fans who block every rival out of love for one trainer.
teams.goal: stop every challenger before they can reach the championship

lines.first: "Oi! No challengers past here! Marnie's orders! (Not really.)"
lines.beaten: "You again?! We'll yell louder this time!"
lines.winning: "Ha! Remember when we beat ya? Go Marnie!"
lines.respect: "Okay, you're alright. Just... don't tell Marnie we lost."

lines.first: "Our chants are louder than your Pokémon!"
lines.beaten: "You out-shouted us? Impossible!"
lines.winning: "Lost your voice? Yell with us next time."
lines.respect: "Fine, you get one cheer. Just one."

lines.first: "Team Yell's my sister's mess. Guess that makes it my mess."
lines.beaten: "You beat me once. Let's make this one a proper encore."
lines.winning: "Back for an encore, huh? Didn't learn the lyrics?"
lines.respect: "Right. You're the real thing. I'll stop holding back."

lines.first: "No crowd tonight. Just you, me, and the noise."
lines.beaten: "Last time you stole the show. Not again."
lines.winning: "You can't out-sing the encore, kid."
lines.respect: "This is the best show I've played in years."

rule.text: Team Yell never shuts up: one more Pokémon in every battle.

ops.name: Stadium Blockade
ops.text: Team Yell is blocking the stadium so nobody but Marnie can enter.

ops.name: Route Chant-Off
ops.text: Team Yell has taken over a route and won't let anyone through.

ops.name: Ticket Scalping
ops.text: Team Yell is buying up every match ticket and reselling them.

ops.name: Fan Drive
ops.text: Team Yell is recruiting new grunts with free scarves.

teams.name: Team Star
teams.philosophy: We stood up to bullies once. Now nobody tells us what to do.
teams.motivation: Students who banded together after being bullied, now bullying back.
teams.goal: drive every other trainer off the academy grounds

lines.first: "Star Barrage! You don't belong here!"
lines.beaten: "Not you again! You're messing with our vibe!"
lines.winning: "Ha! Remember how we beat you? Starfall!"
lines.respect: "Okay... you're not a bully. Maybe you can stay."

lines.first: "Starmobile's tuned and ready. Want a ride? No? Then battle!"
lines.beaten: "You scratched the Starmobile! Rematch!"
lines.winning: "Engine's still warm from last time, slowpoke."
lines.respect: "Okay, your team runs smoother than our cars."

lines.first: "Dark crew boss here. Drop the beat, then drop out."
lines.beaten: "You broke my rhythm last time. Not again."
lines.winning: "Same song as before? It ends the same way."
lines.respect: "You've got rhythm. Respect, for real."

lines.first: "You think you can just walk into our base? Ugh!"
lines.beaten: "You embarrassed me! In front of my crew!"
lines.winning: "You lost to me! So go home already!"
lines.respect: "Fine! You're not a bully. You're just... really good."

rule.text: Team Star bosses rely on one Starmobile ace: one less Pokémon, two levels higher.

ops.name: Base Blockade
ops.text: Team Star has set up a base camp and closed the road behind it.

ops.name: Class Crashing
ops.text: Team Star is crashing the local trainer school and scaring off students.

ops.name: Star Recruitment
ops.text: Team Star is recruiting new grunts with shiny jackets.

ops.name: Ruins Claim
ops.text: Team Star has camped out in ruins where something ancient roars.

event.name: Suspicious Trainers
event.intro: Two {grunt}s whisper about a "{front}" shipment and go quiet when they see you.

success.text: "Mind your own business!"
You hear the name {team}, and the word "{goal}".
You walk on. Later you spot the {front} logo on a crate by the road.

event.name: {front} Files
event.intro: A dropped folder lies by the path: shipping lists, Pokémon names, and a red {team} stamp.

success.text: You tuck the folder away. Someone will want this later.
Officer Jenny thanks you and opens a case on {front}.

effects.text: Handed the {team} files to the police

success.text: A {grunt} pays you to forget what you saw.

effects.text: Sold the {team} files back to them

event.name: {team} Knows Your Face
event.intro: A {specialist} blocks the road. "You're the one who keeps showing up. {team} has a file on you now."

success.text: "Then let's see what the file is worth."
"Wrong kid, I guess." They walk off, confused.

event.name: {exec}
event.intro: {exec} steps out of a black car, flanked by grunts. {team}'s rising star wants to meet the trainer who keeps getting in the way.

success.text: "Let me show you why I outrank them."
{exec} laughs. "Smart. Stay smart." {team} grows bolder.

event.name: {exec} Returns
event.intro: {exec} is back, with a stronger team, and a {grunt} in the back is looking at you like they want out.

success.text: "This time it ends differently."
While {exec} rants, the grunt slips away with you. "I know how their base works. I'll help."
You point out the deserter. {exec} smiles and pays you. The grunt is dragged away.

event.name: {team}'s Real Plan
event.intro: Behind a door marked "{front}: staff only", a whiteboard spells it out: {team} means to {goal}. {motive}

success.text: You copy everything, and slip out with a prototype.
The League promises help when you storm the base. Allies gather.
You tell no one. When the time comes, this is your fight.

event.name: {team} Hideout
event.intro: You found it: {team}'s secret base. {leader} is inside. This is where it ends, one way or another.

success.text: Grunts scatter. {leader} waits at the top.

choices.label: Let the defector open a back door

success.text: The defector leads you past every guard, straight to {leader}.

win.text: Brought down {leader} with a defector's help

success.text: Your files hit every newspaper. {front} is raided by morning, and {leader} flees the region without a fight.

effects.text: Exposed {team} to the world without a fight

success.text: {leader} smiles. "Finally, someone sensible." You walk out richer, and {team} walks out stronger.
"Intruder!"
In a borrowed uniform you walk right in, swap a few wires, and walk out with their supplies.
You leave them to it. {team} pulls it off.
They pay well, and they remember who helped.

event.name: {team} Ambush
event.intro: {team} grunts drop out of the trees! "That's the one the boss told us about!"

success.text: "Get them!"
You lose them in the tall grass.

event.name: {front} Booth
event.intro: A friendly booth hands out flyers for "{front}". The smiling clerk wears a familiar pin under the scarf.

success.text: Cheap, and they wave you off warmly. Your money funds {team}.
"That pin is {team}'s!" The crowd turns on the booth and the shop owner rewards you.

failure.text: The clerk drops the smile. "You shouldn't have said that."

success.text: You keep your money and your suspicions.

event.name: A Legend Stirs
event.intro: With {team} gone, the Pokémon they hunted no longer needs to hide. Something huge moves ahead.

success.text: It rises to test the one who saved it.
You bow and walk on. It watches you go.

effects.text: Let the Legendary {team} hunted rest in peace

event.name: {team} Holding Pen
event.intro: Behind a {front} warehouse, stolen Pokémon sit in cages, waiting to be shipped out.

success.text: "Hey! Those are the boss's!"

win.text: Freed the Pokémon in a {team} holding pen

success.text: You slip the locks one by one. One of the freed Pokémon will not leave your side.

effects.text: Freed the Pokémon in a {team} holding pen

win.text: Freed the Pokémon in a {team} holding pen

success.text: You leave them. The trucks roll out at dawn.

effects.text: Left stolen Pokémon in a {team} pen

event.name: Trouble Inside {team}
event.intro: {exec} and a {specialist} are shouting at each other in an alley. "{leader} promised ME that lab!" Neither has noticed you.

success.text: {exec} smirks. "You have taste." {team} eases off you, for now.
The {specialist} owes you now, and slips you their notes. "If you ever need a way in, I know one."

effects.text: Turned a {team} {specialist} into an inside source

success.text: A few well placed words and they come to blows. Their operation here falls apart.
You leave them to it.

hidden.name: {front} Volunteer
hidden.line: Have you heard about {front}? We only want to help. Sign here, and bring your Pokémon.

open.name: Shifty Stranger
open.line: Nice team you got there. Shame if someone... looked after it for you.

plaza.unmask: "That pin is {team}'s!" The crowd turns on them, and they bolt. A shopkeeper slips you a reward.
plaza.buy: They sell you something cheap and wave you off warmly. Your money funds {team}.
plaza.allied: {exec} sends a crate of supplies your way. "Partners look after each other."
plaza.controlled: {team} runs this region's trade: prices are up {percent}% until they are stopped.
